Feature: Verify navigation to Change Password page and input elements
Description: Verify navigation to Change Password page and input elements
Pre-condition: The user is logged in to OrangeHRM with valid credentials and the Dashboard has loaded. The user has navigated to the Change Password page.
Test Steps: 1. Perform the actions described in the test title
Expected Result:
- The browser URL should match a value matching /updatePassword/
- The orangehrm main title element should display the text 'Update Password'
- The password element should be visible
